composition: horizontal panorama, twin disc targets framing center
description: Mixed-media collage on a horizontal ground incorporates USPS Priority Mail envelopes, outlined warplane silhouettes, concentric target circles, iridescent compact discs, a football, red chess pawn, cartoon figure cutouts, and neon yellow and red rectangular overlays. Layered printed ephemera and hand-drawn elements occupy the entire picture plane in a dense, overlapping arrangement.
title: Untitled (Twin Discs in Targets)
